rules.title: Required entry file and metadata
rules.expected_observation: SKILL.md exists, its opening --- is the file's first line, and it parses as a YAML mapping with name and description; optional folders are not demanded.
rules.limitation: Claude Code falls back to the directory name and the first non-empty markdown line when the fields are absent, so absence degrades discovery rather than breaking loading. Bounded development observation; no framework acceptance.

rules.title: Name and description constraints
rules.expected_observation: Name is 1-64 lowercase letters/digits with single separating hyphens matching the original directory identity; description is a nonempty string of at most 1024 characters.
rules.limitation: Sources disagree on the boundaries: the Claude Code reference states no name length limit, no reserved-word rule, and a 1,536-character listing truncation for description plus when_to_use; the Agent Skills specification and the Anthropic authoring guidance state 64 and 1024 character maxima, and the authoring guidance additionally prohibits XML tags and the reserved words anthropic and claude. Only the constraints both sides support are required here. The disputed ones are emitted as advisory divergences by scripts/skill_format.py advisory_checks and must not be reported as defects. Directory identity compares the original root, not a renamed snapshot folder.

rules.title: Supported optional field types
rules.expected_observation: Present optional fields hold supported Claude Code shapes and value domains: allowed-tools and disallowed-tools as a string or a nonempty list of strings; paths and arguments likewise; metadata and hooks as mappings; disable-model-invocation, user-invocable and background as booleans accepting true/false, yes/no, on/off and 1/0 in any case; effort in low/medium/high/xhigh/max; shell in bash/powershell; context equal to fork; compatibility 1-500 characters; metadata mapping string keys to string values.
rules.limitation: A YAML-list allowed-tools is valid Claude Code and non-conformant to the Agent Skills specification, which defines only a space-separated string and marks the field experimental; the divergence is advisory, never a defect. Fields outside the supported table are an applicability question, not a failure. The installed Skill Creator checker omits compatibility and is a separately recorded limited observation.

rules.title: Optional frontmatter configuration and absent host configuration file
rules.expected_observation: Optional frontmatter fields express actual supported invocation policy and tool interfaces. Claude Code reads no separate metadata or configuration file, so a package carrying agents/openai.yaml or another host's configuration document holds bytes this host never reads and needs a disposition decision; an absent optional field is not a defect.
rules.limitation: Do not enforce sample keys as required, and do not parse another host's configuration against a Claude Code contract. Explicit invocation differs from automatic discovery: disable-model-invocation: true removes the description from context and leaves /name working.

rules.title: Focused triggers and routing

locator.section: How skill triggering works; Writing effective descriptions

rules.expected_observation: Positive and near-miss prompts classify with stated scope; report classification separately from native invocation.
rules.limitation: The description is the entire trigger, written in third person, stating what the skill does and the contexts that should invoke it. Near-miss and duplicate-name behavior is observed, not asserted; description classification is separate from actual native implicit activation.

rules.title: Progressive disclosure

locator.section: Skill structure: Progressive disclosure patterns; Avoid deeply nested references

rules.expected_observation: Essential decisions are reachable from entrypoint; conditional details are linked and loaded when needed.
rules.limitation: Under 500 lines for the SKILL.md body and one-level-deep references are recommendations with stated reasons, not universal caps. Demonstrate retrieval or workflow harm before proposing a fix.

rules.expected_observation: Instructions make the intended result and step inputs/outputs understandable.
rules.limitation: Checklists, validator feedback loops and verifiable intermediate outputs are recommended patterns for complex or high-stakes work, not required anatomy for every skill.

rules.title: Grounded prompt structure and examples

locator.section: Core principles: Concise is key; Set appropriate degrees of freedom; Common patterns
Start from real expertise; Spending context wisely

rules.expected_observation: Instructions add context the model lacks, match specificity to task fragility, keep terminology consistent, avoid time-sensitive statements, and use concrete input/output examples where output quality depends on seeing them.
rules.limitation: These are authoring recommendations for skills, not API parameters. Do not apply API prompt guidance to an instruction-only skill and do not impose a fixed example count.

rules.title: Model-specific follow-through

locator.section: Core principles: Test with all models you plan to use

rules.expected_observation: Instructions honor current user intent, avoid repeated approval rituals, and are exercised against the models the skill is actually intended for.
rules.limitation: Model-specific tuning is conditional on the identified host and model; no model selection is mandatory and an absent model override inherits the session. Cross-model coverage is unverified unless a trial actually ran it.

rules.title: Citation identity and support
rules.expected_observation: Cite stable observed sources with precise supporting locators.
rules.limitation: No Anthropic or Claude Code citation-formatting source was retrieved for this revision, so the prior OpenAI citation-formatting authority is dropped rather than carried forward under a host it does not describe. The requirement survives as project policy. Syntax does not prove support; special citation renderers are not required for Markdown reports. Freshness for an official-host citation source is unavailable and remains an open sourcing question.
